## Session Context (opencode-cli-mcp)

You have access to opencode-cli-mcp: opencode agent runs plus an eternal session depot (every opencode session since install, searchable SQLite).

**Before starting work, recall what you already know:**

1. Wayback find: `opencode_depot(action="search", query="<topic>")` — full-text across all transcripts and titles
2. Live state: `opencode_system(action="status")`, recent runs: `opencode_runs(action="list", limit=10)`

**At the end of meaningful work:**
- Review what changed: `opencode_sessions(action="diff", session_id=...)`; cancel stuck runs: `opencode_runs(action="cancel", job_id=...)`
- Protect the depot: `opencode_backups(action="create", kind="all")` (autobackup runs every 24h)
